info.title: stability/edit-search-and-replace
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "stability/edit-search-and-replace", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Comfy Router request for Stability search-and-replace, in Stability's edit fields sent as a JSON object. Finds `search_prompt` in `image` and replaces it with `prompt`. Returns one PNG and is billed once per call.

grow_mask.description: How far, in pixels, to grow the found area. Default 3.

image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the source image.

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the replacement.

prompt.description: What to put in place of the found object.

search_prompt.description: What to find in the image.

seed.description: 0 or omitted picks a random seed.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for the Stability image models. The image is generated on Comfy-hosted infrastructure and stored on Comfy storage: `image` is a Comfy-signed URL valid for up to 24 hours, not a Stability URL, so download it before then. If the image cannot be stored, the call answers 502 and is not billed; no other URL is returned.

image.description: Comfy-signed URL of the (first) PNG image, valid for up to 24 hours.

images.description: SDXL only, when more than one image was returned. Every Comfy-signed image URL, in output order, each valid for up to 24 hours.

seed.description: The seed the image was generated with.
